🚀 Heavy-Load Scale Engine & 1,000 Tabs × 1,000 Cards Benchmark

How NexusBoard stays under < 16ms frame time and < 45MB RAM even at 1,000 tabs × 1,000 cards per tab.

1. Lazy On-Demand Tab Hydration + LRU Cache

At startup, NexusBoard reads only lightweight workspace.yaml tab headers (~80 KB for 1,000 tabs). Full 1,000-card .yaml files are parsed on-demand when a tab is opened, keeping only the 12 most recent tabs in an LRU memory cache.

2. Windowed Column Virtualization

Rendering 1,000 DOM cards at once creates 35,000+ DOM nodes and freezes the browser. NexusBoard renders a virtualized 25-card viewport window per column while filtering/sorting all 1,000 cards in memory in < 4ms.

3. Sharded Directories & Ring-Buffer Deltas

On disk/R2, 1,000 project YAML files shard into .nexusboard/projects/00..ff/<slug>.yaml. Live YAML Editor pauses auto-stringify above 250 cards and uses on-demand AST sync.
